alec: Heads-up: after landing a small RBAC rollback for ns=priv-hsm I see unexpected outbound TLS to a previously unknown host 198.51.100.22 from hsm-mirror-proxy. Patch was to remove cluster-admin grant.

ops-bot: [ANOMALY] priv-hsm cluster outbound to 198.51.100.22 detected 2026-10-05T09:12Z. 12 connections from system:serviceaccount:priv-hsm:hsm-mirror-proxy.

anita: Oncall. Paste the kubectl patch you applied and the exact service account. Also check whether audit-shim relay was healthy (we had a recent rotation bug).

alec: Patch: `kubectl patch clusterrolebinding hsm-crb --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/roleRef/name","value":"hsm-readonly"}]'` at 09:10:58Z. SA: hsm-mirror-proxy.

priya: I pulled node and pod logs. There are GET /v1/sign calls from that SA token right after the patch. However audit-shim-bot shows a gap: audit-relay restarted at 09:09 and missed ~2m due to leader-election flapping.

dinesh: That means we lack full kube-audit coverage during the RBAC change window. Containment: rotate SA token, patch deployment to use temp-noegress SA, apply VPC deny for 198.51.100.22, and snapshot pod fs.

maria: I'll open vuln-triage INC-2026-995, collect whatever audit slices we have, contact compliance. Also we need to fix audit-shim leader-election bug and add an alert for audit gaps during RBAC changes.

anita: Agreed. Postmortem tasks: 1) make RBAC changes gated by a short audit-health probe that ensures audit-relay leader stable 2) require egress smoke test for secrets/signing SAs 3) rotate long-lived tokens and enforce TTLs 4) scan images for baked-in credentials.

alec: Containment executed: rotated token, patched SA, applied VPC deny, preserving artifacts. Will add timelines to INC-2026-995.
